# Pinned Python dependencies for the validate-workflows lint suite.
# Used by:
#   - .github/workflows/validate-workflows.yml (Install lint dependencies step)
#   - Makefile (lint-workflows target — install hint)
#
# Pinned rather than floating for the same reason the Lambda suites pin: these
# back structural fences, and a fence whose verdict can change without a code
# change is not a fence. A jsonschema minor can tighten or relax validation;
# that should land as a reviewed bump, not as a surprise red on an unrelated PR.
#
# Bump in lockstep with upstream releases. Note the repo's 7-day dependency
# quarantine (age-check) — pick a release at least a week old.
jsonschema==4.26.0
pyyaml==6.0.3
